description: This is a 3D model of a multi-level stair tower with an open-air design. The structure features curved platforms at each level, connected by a central concrete core and a spiral wooden staircase. The platforms have railings for safety, and small human figures are included to give a sense of scale. The top level is partially covered by a roof. The entire structure is elevated on a wooden base that resembles a tiled floor. The design appears to be modern and minimalist, suitable for outdoor observation or as a unique architectural feature.
